name: Wall returns with a split step
summary: Alone at a wall, hit a deep, high return above a tape line off the bounce, move forward and split-step before the rebound.
setup: Tape a line on the wall about 1.5 m above the floor (well above net height) and stand about 6 m from the wall
Toss the ball against the wall so it rebounds and bounces once in front of you, like a serve coming in
Return it off the bounce with a smooth stroke above the line, then take two to three walking steps forward and split-step (feet apart, balanced) before the rebound reaches you
Catch the rebound or let it go; walk back and repeat. Sets of 10
success_criterion: In each of 3 sets of 10 returns, at least 8 hit the wall above the line and you are balanced in your split step before the rebound bounces on at least 7
safety_notes: Walk forward, never sprint, and always face the wall; never backpedal to reach a rebound, let it go. Clear the floor of loose balls between sets. Stop if dizzy or in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) A deep return plus moving forward in balance is how the receiving side reaches the non-volley-zone line and wins rallies on receive (AN-02). The split step makes the move-in part of the stroke, alone and with no court. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
